The Practice

A new practice, built on twenty years of experience.

Studio Retford is a newly established, independent architectural practice in Retford, Nottinghamshire, led by a CIAT Chartered architectural professional with 20 years of industry experience.

We specialise in small to medium-sized residential and commercial projects — new homes, extensions, renovations and business premises — designed carefully around the people who will use them, and the places they will stand in.

Our Philosophy

Good Architecture Begins With Understanding.

Before a single line is drawn, we take time to understand — the people, the place, and the purpose a building must serve, not just on the day it is finished, but for decades afterwards.

i.

The People

How you live, work and gather shapes every plan. We design around real routines, not assumptions.

ii.

The Place

A building belongs to its setting — its light, landscape, materials and neighbours all inform the design.

iii.

The Purpose

Function first: rooms that work, spaces that flow, and details resolved before they become problems.

iv.

The Long Term

Honest materials and sound construction, chosen to age gracefully and serve you well for years.

How We Work

The Design Process

01

Initial Consultation

We begin with a conversation — your site, your ambitions, your budget — and an honest view of what is achievable.

02

Brief & Concept Design

Your requirements become a clear brief, then early concept sketches exploring layout, light and form.

03

Design Development

The chosen concept is refined into detailed drawings, with materials, structure and costs considered throughout.

04

Planning & Project Support

We prepare and support your planning application and documentation, and remain on hand as the project progresses.

About

An independent practice, designed around people.

Studio Retford is a newly established architectural practice based in Retford, Nottinghamshire. Though the practice itself is new, it is founded on 20 years of professional experience in architectural design — experience gained across residential and commercial projects of all kinds.

The practice is led personally by its founder, a CIAT Chartered architectural professional. That means when you work with us, you work directly with the person designing your project — from the first conversation to the final drawings. No hand-offs, no juniors learning at your expense, and no call centres.

We specialise in small to medium-sized projects: new homes, extensions, alterations and renovations for homeowners, and considered premises for small businesses. Our approach combines thoughtful, design-led thinking with practical, buildable solutions — architecture that looks right, works properly, and stands the test of time.

  • i.Personal by design — one point of contact, who knows your project in detail.
  • ii.Thoughtful & practical — creative design grounded in how buildings are actually built.
  • iii.Honest guidance — clear advice on feasibility, planning and cost from the outset.
